name: ryntra-arc
description: Check a Ryntra settlement receipt yourself: its schema, its canonical serialization and seals, and the transfer, payout or USDC/EURC exchange it records read back from Arc.
author: Dmytro Plavutskyi

scripts.test: node --test packages/arc-verify/src/canonical.test.mjs packages/arc-verify/src/receipt.test.mjs packages/arc-verify/src/schema.test.mjs packages/arc-verify/src/chain.test.mjs packages/arc-verify/src/check.test.mjs packages/arc-verify/src/verify.test.mjs packages/arc-verify/src/cli.test.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run verify:boundaries
